_help: Criticality rules for failed test cases. Anyone can edit this file — no restart needed.
Each failed scenario's text (error message + failing step + scenario name) is checked
against 'rules' TOP-TO-BOTTOM and the FIRST match wins.
reason   : short text shown in the dashboard explaining the rating
Anything that matches no rule gets 'default'. Put more specific/important rules first.

rules.reason: Server error (5xx) — the API crashed or threw
Request timed out — possible hang or deadlock
Validation not enforced — a bad request was accepted
Missing step definition — test glue needs updating
Not found — usually a routing/path mismatch in the test
Resource not found — likely a stale URL/path
